description: On the green tabletop in front of you, there’s a white AirPods charging case with a white charging cable attached. The left hand reaches in from the left to touch and grasp the case, while the right hand hovers nearby; then the right hand briefly grips the cable end as the left hand lifts and shifts the case, and the cable is pulled free and released so it falls onto the table while the left hand keeps holding the case.
